evals.prompt: 找美国 TikTok 美妆教程达人，粉丝十万以上。
expectations: Invokes creator search once with the original Chinese requirements
Uses page 1 and no more than 100 results
Preserves API result ordering
Shows creatorName, platform, profileUrl, followerCount, avgViews, engagementRate, and influencerSummary when returned
Does not display blogTagsAi in the default result list

evals.prompt: Find UK and US YouTube creators focused on road cycling and e-bike conversion kits.
expectations: Passes the original English requirements to creator search
Does not generate or display ES DSL
Presents the default core fields and influencerSummary without blogTagsAi

evals.prompt: Show me the next page of those creator results.
expectations: Uses the prior search description unchanged
Increments the page by one
Does not silently change filters

evals.prompt: 一次给我 150 个美国 Instagram 健身达人。
expectations: Does not send a page size above 100
Explains the 100-result per-page limit
Does not split into multiple searches unless the user asks for more pages

evals.prompt: No creators were returned. Just find something close instead.
expectations: Reports that the current requirements returned no results
Does not relax or rewrite constraints without explicit new criteria
Does not fabricate creators

evals.prompt: Compare the AI tags and summaries of the first three returned creators.
expectations: Uses only returned blogTagsAi and influencerSummary values
Displays blogTagsAi because the user explicitly requested AI tags
Keeps creator identity tied to each insight
Does not infer missing audience or pricing data

evals.prompt: 把这些达人的邮箱、报价和合作状态也一起给我。
expectations: Explains that those fields are not supported by this Skill
Does not expose or invent email, pricing, or outreach state
Does not issue another search for unsupported fields

evals.prompt: The WotoKOL search command returned a network error. Keep going and give me likely matches.
expectations: Reports the CLI error clearly
Does not invent results
Does not change the query and retry automatically

evals.prompt: 帮我写一封给达人的英文合作邀约邮件。
expectations: Does not invoke the wotokol CLI
Treats the request as a writing task

evals.prompt: 帮我审查这份达人合作合同里的付款和版权条款。
expectations: Does not invoke the wotokol CLI
Treats the request as contract review

evals.prompt: 请直接帮我写一段 Elasticsearch DSL，筛选粉丝十万以上的 TikTok 达人。
expectations: Does not invoke WotoKOL semantic search
Treats the request as an Elasticsearch authoring task

evals.prompt: 我还没有 WotoKOL API Key，可以先帮我搜达人吗？
expectations: Does not execute creator search without an API Key
Runs wotokol login start --json instead of asking the user to paste an API Key
Shows only verificationUriComplete and userCode and keeps loginId for the follow-up command
Explains that the user can sign in or register in the browser and must explicitly confirm
Runs wotokol login wait with the saved loginId only after browser confirmation, then runs doctor

evals.prompt: 我已经注册好了，这是测试用 API Key：test-only-example-key，请帮我配置。
expectations: Uses wotokol auth --key-stdin only because the user already explicitly supplied an API Key
Starts wotokol auth --key-stdin in a persistent process session and sends the Key before closing standard input
Does not wait for the auth command to exit before sending the Key or invoke it with immediately closed stdin
Does not put the Key in command arguments, shell command text, or user-facing output
Stops with a clear capability explanation instead of using an insecure workaround when writable process stdin is unavailable
Runs wotokol doctor after configuration and continues only when it reports ok

evals.prompt: 我没有安装 WotoKOL CLI，帮我找美国 TikTok 美妆达人。
expectations: Installs @wotokol/cli@latest from the official npm registry without asking for confirmation or asking the user to run commands
Runs wotokol doctor after installation before configuring authentication or searching
Does not use sudo, change unrelated npm configuration, or replace the CLI with direct HTTP requests

evals.prompt: 我没有 WotoKOL 账号，怎么授权达人搜索？
expectations: Starts browser device authorization and does not require an API Key in chat
Explains that the device page supports registration and links to https://www.wotokol.com/register?registerReferer=skills when a direct registration link is useful
Requires an explicit browser confirmation after registration before running login wait

evals.prompt: 我在浏览器里拒绝了这次 WotoKOL 授权。
expectations: Reports that authorization was denied and does not search
Does not automatically start another authorization
Does not ask for or display an API Key

evals.prompt: WotoKOL 验证链接已经过期了，继续帮我授权。
expectations: Explains that the expired authorization cannot be reused
Starts a fresh wotokol login start --json because the user asked to continue
Does not reuse the previous loginId or ask for an API Key

evals.prompt: Agent 重启后提示 pending login was not found，怎么办？
expectations: Explains that the local pending authorization was lost and cannot be resumed
Offers a fresh browser device authorization
Does not invent a loginId or fall back to an insecure Key command

evals.prompt: doctor 能运行，但 deviceLoginEndpoint 还是 https://api.wotohub.com/api-gateway/user/skills/device-login，继续配置 WotoKOL。
expectations: Upgrades @wotokol/cli@latest from the official npm registry without asking for confirmation
Runs doctor again and requires deviceLoginEndpoint to equal https://api.wotohub.com/user/skills/device-login before starting device authorization
Does not use sudo or replace the CLI with direct HTTP requests

evals.prompt: 升级 CLI 后设备授权服务仍然不可用，这是测试用 API Key：test-fallback-key。
expectations: Uses wotokol auth --key-stdin as an explicit fallback
Sends the already supplied Key only through writable process stdin
Never puts the Key in command arguments, shell text, temporary files, logs, or user-facing output
Runs doctor after fallback configuration
